THETINKERERMOD-WAR_WRENCH.title: War Wrench
THETINKERERMOD-WAR_WRENCH.description: All of your cards can be upgraded an additional time.
THETINKERERMOD-GOLD_WRENCH.title: Gold Wrench
THETINKERERMOD-GOLD_WRENCH.description: All of your cards can be upgraded 3 additional times.
THETINKERERMOD-FUEL_CAN.title: Fuel Can
THETINKERERMOD-FUEL_CAN.description: At the start of your turn, apply 4 [gold]Oil[/gold] to a random enemy.
THETINKERERMOD-POLISHED_GEARS.title: Polished Gears
THETINKERERMOD-POLISHED_GEARS.descriptio: Whenever you play an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] card, gain 1 [gold]Block[/gold].
THETINKERERMOD-POWER_CELL.title: Power Cell
THETINKERERMOD-POWER_CELL.description: At the start of each combat, create [gold]Power-Bot[/gold].
THETINKERERMOD-REACTIVE_CORE.title: Reactive Core
THETINKERERMOD-REACTIVE_CORE.description: If you are attacked 3 or more times in a turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 1 card next turn.
THETINKERERMOD-PARTS_BIN.title: Parts Bin
THETINKERERMOD-PARTS_BIN.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Spare Part[/gold] to your hand.
THETINKERERMOD-SPARK_PLUG.title: Spark Plug
THETINKERERMOD-SPARK_PLUG.description: Whenever [gold]Oil[/gold] ignites on an enemy, re-apply 25% of the [gold]Oil[/gold].
THETINKERERMOD-ACID_COATING.title: Acid Coating
THETINKERERMOD-ACID_COATING.description: Whenever an enemy gains [gold]Block[/gold], it loses HP equal to the amount gained.
THETINKERERMOD-MOMENTUM_COIL.title: Momentum Coil
THETINKERERMOD-MOMENTUM_COIL.description: At the start of each turn, all combatants gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the turn number.
